description: Required the shoe, and set dinner at Bartholomew's call.
name: Anne Shakespeare

description: Called the stop, and called the field unchanged.
name: Bartholomew Hathaway

description: Put the bread in the cloth and the wide stall in reach.
name: Joan Shakespeare

description: Sent a back to the sickle, and kept barley's price for the table.
name: John Shakespeare

description: Ate the bread and kept the hour to an hour.
name: William Shakespeare
